title: Autocomplete fails when inline cast is used in onready variable declaration
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.6.1.stable, v4.7.beta2 [777579205]

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta2 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6603) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-5930K CPU @ 3.50GHz (12 threads) - 31.83 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Possibly related to #92219 . If an inline cast is added to an `@onready` variable declaration, autocomplete will **NOT** work for the parameter path as shown below. Sample project included (created in 4.7 beta2).

This issue is most likely to occur if a user is trying to satisfy the "safe line" indication by using **explicit typing and an inline cast**, instead of using an inferred declaration (1st "broken" scenario below). That said, the inferred declaration + inline cast (2nd "broken" scenario below) is less likely to occur, since inference already satisfies the "safe line".

Of course, the argument is that it's safest to skip the inline cast so it won't silently fail if the variable is null, but since both the [GDScript style guide](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_styleguide.html#inferred-types) and the [static typing reference](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/static_typing.html#safe-lines) show an example of using an inline cast for an `@onready` variable, it's a scenario that is still likely to occur in some contexts (and which triggers the autocomplete to **fail** in this case).

Thank you for looking into this.

```gdscript
extends Node3D

## Autocomplete WORKS:
@onready var animation_tree: AnimationTree = $AnimationTree
#@onready var animation_tree := $AnimationTree

## Autocomplete BROKEN:
#@onready var animation_tree: AnimationTree = $AnimationTree as AnimationTree
#@onready var animation_tree := $AnimationTree as AnimationTree


func jump() -> void:
	## Re-type first half of the line below when swapping @onready versions above to test autocomplete
	#animation_tree.set(&"parameters/OneShot/request", AnimationNodeOneShot.ONE_SHOT_REQUEST_FIRE)
	
	pass
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open attached sample project, and **test.gd** script.
2. For either the explicit or inferred variable declaration shown in the "WORKS" category, re-typing the indicated line will correctly autocomplete the `&"parameters/OneShot/request"` section.
3. For either the explicit or inferred variable declaration shown in the "BROKEN" category with the addition of the inline cast, re-typing the indicated line will **NOT** autocomplete the parameter path.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[AutoCompleteBug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28357319/AutoCompleteBug.zip)
